newsitem.title: USA: Hecla Mining, Santa Fe Gold in agreement.
newsitem.headline: Hecla Mining, Santa Fe Gold in agreement.

text.p: Hecla Mining Co and Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp said Tuesday the final agreement for the 50/50 joint venture to develop the Rosebud gold property has been signed.

The Rosebud gold property, an underground, high-grade oxide gold deposit, is 50 miles west of Winnemucca, Nevada, and is expected to produce an average of about 100,000 ounces of gold annually for five years, it said.

Initial production is expected in the second quarter of 1997, it added. Construction of the surface facilities and infrastructure at the mine site began in August, and additional underground development will begin during the fourth quarter.
Details of the joint-venture arrangement were first reported on May 28, when the letter of intent was signed.
Under the agreement, the mine will be operated by Hecla and ore will be trucked to Santa Fe's Twin Creeks mine for processing.
